Chronic kidney disease is deﬁ ned as either kidney damage or GFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m2 for 3 months or longer. Kidney damage is deﬁ ned as
pathologic abnormalities or markers of damage, including abnormalities in blood or urine tests or imaging studies.
